stimulus: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) At the age of eleven he showed his poetic genius. (b) His famous poem 'Bidrohi' stirred the whole nation. (c) Our national poet Kazi Nazrul Islam was born is 1306 B.S (1899 A.D.) at Churulia in the district of Burdwan. (d) In 1914 when the First World War broke out, he wanted to join the army. (e) In 1972, he was brought to Bangladesh from Kolkata and was declared our national poet. (f) His poem inspired our freedom fighters in the liberation war of Bangladesh. (g) On his return from the battle field, he gave up the sword for the pen and began to write poems. (h) At last at the age of 19 he joined the army as an ordinary soldiers.
